bullets.text: Three pony handlers were arrested in Chennai for robbing a couple at knifepoint on Besant Nagar Beach, and the office should monitor public safety.
Police arrested three men involved in the Besant Nagar Beach robbery following the early Friday incident, and the office should track further investigations.
Potholes have developed across thousands of Chennai roads due to recent rain, and the office should coordinate road repairs with local authorities.
Chennai residents face air quality monitoring issues as monitors fail ahead of Diwali, and the office should urge the corporation to fix the sensor network.

stories.title: Three pony handlers arrested for robbing couple on Besant Nagar Beach
takeaways: Three pony handlers were arrested for robbing a young couple at knifepoint on Besant Nagar Beach.
Local law enforcement action follows the incident, highlighting security concerns in a key constituency area.

stories.title: Potholes develop on more roads in Chennai owing to rain

reports.title: Greater Chennai Corporation fixes 1,531 of 13,227 potholes after rains

takeaways: Heavy rains caused 13227 potholes across 2953 roads throughout Chennai city infrastructure.
Municipal authorities must repair dangerous road damage before public safety issues escalate further.

stories.title: City’s AQI stagnation: no new monitors, existing monitors don’t relay data
takeaways: Chennai citizens lack reliable air quality data as state monitors fail and sensors go blank.
The 62 crore sensor network malfunction leaves residents blind during Diwali firecracker smoke.
